value.name: Pneumonia
value.description: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs. The air sacs may fill with fluid or pus, causing cough with phlegm or pus, fever, chills, and difficulty breathing.
symptoms: Chest pain when you breathe or cough

value.name: Bronchitis
value.description: Bronchitis is inflammation of the lining of your bronchial tubes, which carry air to and from your lungs. People who have bronchitis often cough up thickened mucus, which can be discolored. It can be acute or chronic.
symptoms: Production of mucus (sputum), which can be clear, white, yellowish-white or greenish-brown

value.name: Asthma
value.description: Asthma is a chronic condition that causes inflammation and narrowing of the airways. This can lead to wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing. Symptoms can vary in severity and frequency.
symptoms: Trouble sleeping caused by shortness of breath, coughing or wheezing

value.name: Pleurisy
value.description: Pleurisy, also called pleuritis, is inflammation of the pleura, the membranes that line the lungs and the inside of the chest cavity. This inflammation causes sharp chest pain that worsens when you breathe, cough, or sneeze.
symptoms: Pain that worsens with breathing, coughing, or sneezing

value.name: Pulmonary Embolism
value.description: A pulmonary embolism (PE) occurs when a blood clot travels to the lungs and blocks one of the pulmonary arteries. This can cause sudden shortness of breath, chest pain, and coughing up blood. It is a life-threatening condition.
symptoms: Chest pain, often sharp and worse with deep breathing or coughing
Coughing up blood or pink, foamy mucus
